posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared a cozy May photo dump with husband Vicky Kaushal and baby Vihaan, offering fans a rare peek into family life.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Imtiaz Ali film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' is holding strong at the box office, while his viral behind-the-scenes moment with Naseeruddin Shah delighted fans.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: The 'Alpha' trailer dropped, launching Alia into the YRF Spy Universe alongside Sharvari, with buzz around a Hrithik Roshan cameo.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka celebrated Father's Day by gifting matching sneakers to Nick Jonas and daughter Malti, amid buzz over her US homeware line and a rumored Bhansali comeback.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's ambitious 'King', co-starring daughter Suhana and Deepika Padukone, is eyeing a Christmas release as leaked BTS clips set social media abuzz.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena cheered on sister Karisma's web series 'Brown', calling her 'the absolute '90s Queen' in a heartfelt note.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: The teaser of Shraddha's 'Eetha' arrived attached with 'Cocktail 2', and the film locked an August 28 release date.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is expecting her second child with Ranveer Singh, with father Prakash Padukone opening up warmly about the family's next chapter.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's 'Dhurandhar' is heading to a Japan release, as the actor reportedly steps back from interviews to focus on his upcoming slate.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya turned heads at Cannes 2026 with a blush-pink gown and a striking sapphire 'Luminara' look, marking her 24th year on the red carpet with daughter Aaradhya by her side.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's 'Cocktail 2' hit theatres alongside Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon, even as she teased an intense shoot for her solo lead film 'Mysaa'.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha is promoting 'Maa Inti Bangaram' and won hearts with a viral candid moment with husband Raj Nidimoru at a recent event.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun kicked off shooting for his ambitious Atlee collaboration 'AA22xA6' opposite Deepika Padukone, while praising Ram Charan's transformation in 'Peddi'.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama 'Peddi' crossed Rs 300 crore worldwide to become 2026's highest-grossing South Indian film, with makers adding nearly six minutes of fresh footage.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's 'Dragon' with Prashanth Neel was pushed to a June 2027 release, with the star undergoing a dramatic 15-kg transformation for the two-part epic.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi stars opposite Ram Charan in the blockbuster 'Peddi' and reunites with Varun Dhawan for a Shashank Khaitan rom-com, even as her Oscar-entry film 'Homebound' makes headlines.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya shared dreamy glimpses from her 48 hours in Monaco and lit up the stage in a viral father-daughter dance with Chunky Panday.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara made a dazzling post-motherhood runway return as showstopper for Rahul Mishra, ahead of her first theatrical outing as a mom in Yash's 'Toxic'.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik is gearing up for the YRF Spy Universe's 'War 2' alongside Jr NTR, with reports linking him to a cameo in Alia Bhatt's 'Alpha'.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' — his father David Dhawan's final directorial — has emerged among 2026's biggest romantic hits, and he's reuniting with Janhvi Kapoor for a new rom-com.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya announced her global 'Unstoppable Tour', with a packed September run across the US and Canada including Boston, Newark, Toronto, Oakland and LA.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Rahman's soaring soundtrack and score for Ram Charan's 'Peddi' are winning praise as the film dominates the box office.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay's reportedly final film 'Jana Nayagan' inches toward a late-June release after a long censor deadlock, with the superstar offering to refund distributors himself.
